messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: Elevated 5xx rate in eu-west1 (api-gateway). Error rate crossed 4% for 10m, latency p95 spiking. Auto-escalation to on-call SRE.

emma-sre: I'm on it. grabbing logs now. Can someone confirm if this is traffic-specific or provider-level?

raj_platform: Looks like provider A edge nodes in eu-west1 started returning 502s around 06:07 UTC. Provider metrics show increased packet drops.

sara_prod: We're seeing customer-facing errors for some chat endpoints (generation). Impact: degraded availability for ~8% of EU requests, highest for seq_len>1024.

ops-jen: tagging major customers with potential impact: acme-inc, neat-ml. prepping comms if we escalate.

emma-sre: quick mitigation plan: 1) apply partial brownout on heavy-generation routes (seq>1024) in eu-west1 2) reroute new requests to provider-B 3) raise rate limits for non-critical paths to limit bursts. Anyone object?

raj_platform: +1. Suggest CLI steps for graceful drain: 1) set route weight for provider-A -> 0.6 2) enable fallback provider-B for eu-west1 3) apply token-based quick quota for large requests.

sara_prod: Prefer to do a staged brownout by tag so we don't break small prompt workloads. Eg: set header X-Redwood-Seq-Limit: 1024 and reject > limit with 429 and helpful message.

emma-sre: executing now.

emma-sre: ```
# set provider weights (gateway-config)
redwoodctl route update --region eu-west1 --route /v1/generate --provider-weights '{"provider-a":0.5,"provider-b":0.5}'

# brownout rule: reject long sequences
redwoodctl policy add --name eu-long-seq-brownout --region eu-west1 --match 'request.seq_len > 1024' --action 'reject(429, "Seq too long in eu-west1 during mitigations")'
```

deploy-bot: Deployment queued: route-config-update (eu-west1) by emma-sre. Rollout 5% -> 25% -> 100%. Logs: https://deploys.redwood.example/deploys/654321 :gear:

ops-jen: Noting customer comms draft: "We are actively mitigating an infrastructure issue affecting large-generation requests in EU. If you rely on long-context generation, expect transient 429s while we reroute traffic."

emma-sre: First stage 5% applied. Early signals: 5xx rate down from 4.2% -> 3.0% within 90s. P95 latency still elevated.

raj_platform: Kicking off provider reroute for new sessions to provider-B. Command: ```
redwoodctl provider set-fallback --region eu-west1 --primary provider-b --timeout 30s
```

support-bot: Notifying support channels and opening incident thread with PG: https://support.redwood.example/incidents/INC-2026-342 :mailbox_with_mail:

emma-sre: Rolling to 25%. Metrics: 5xx -> 1.6%, user impact narrowed to ~2.1% of EU requests. Good.

sara_prod: Start rate-limiting heuristics on non-critical routes to reduce load: /v1/embed and /v1/align to 10r/s per token for EU. Use soft-queue to avoid dropping sessions.

emma-sre: Applied soft rate limits. Brownout rule enforced. Provider fallback active. Still seeing some error spikes tied to long-live sessions draining from provider-A.

raj_platform: Initiating graceful connection drain on provider-A nodes in eu-west1: set drain_timeout 300s.

emma-sre: ```
redwoodctl provider drain --provider provider-a --region eu-west1 --grace 300s
```

deploy-bot: provider-drain job started by raj_platform.

ops-jen: Customer impact assessment updated: Small percentage of high-cost customers may see degraded throughput for long sequences. No data exfiltration. SLA impact: potential latency SLA blips for 12 customers.

emma-sre: On-call handoff note: I'll monitor next 30m then hand off to matt-sre for overnight. Adding runbook pointer and open actions.

matt-sre: I'll take second shift at 07:10 UTC. Please leave known mitigations and a checklist in thread.

emma-sre: Handoff checklist posted: - provider fallback active - brownout policy id eu-long-seq-brownout - provider-a drain in progress - rate-limits applied to non-critical routes - customer comms draft in ops comms doc.

ops-jen: marking incident as "Mitigated" for active customer impact but still in watch. :white_check_mark: We'll escalate to Incident Review if this recurs.

incident-bot: Incident state updated: mitigated -> watch. Duration so far: ~28m. Pager duty: cleared for incident role #oncall.

matt-sre: Taking watch. If error rate goes above 1.5% for 5m, undo rollout and open emergency reroute to eu-east.

support-bot: Support notifications sent to affected customers. Ticket IDs: TCK-9981, TCK-9982.

emma-sre: Thanks team. Good run. I'll follow up with post-incident notes tomorrow. :thumbsup:
